function listPosts({url,$}) {const posts=[]; $("a[href^=\"/blog/\"]").each((i,e)=>{const a=$(e); const h=a.attr('href'); if(h && true)posts.push({url:h,title:a.text().trim()});});return {posts,next:null};}
function parsePost({url,$}) {const b=$("article").first().clone(); b.find('script,style,nav,.related-posts,.post-navigation,.post-meta,.blog-posts,.upvote-button,form').remove();return {title:$("h1").first().text().trim(),bodyHtml:b.html()||'',author:$('meta[name="author"]').attr('content')||null,publishedAt:$('meta[property="article:published_time"]').attr('content')||$('time[datetime]').first().attr('datetime')||null,tags:[]};}
scraper.notes: 實際頁面DOM：正文 article；標題 h1；首頁文章連結列表。
